title: Tyler on several 1940s crashes in New Mexico
summary: Diana Pasulka tells of Tyler on several 1940s crashes in New Mexico, about 1940s at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it was a secret place uh on government land it was a New Mexico crash retrieval place and it was a place that you know was not Roswell but this is what Tyler told me he said there were a few crashes that happened in the 1940s

plain: Diana Pasulka, a scholar who writes about religion and UFOs, tells on Jesse Michels' podcast what a source she calls Tyler told her. According to Tyler, there was a secret place on government land in New Mexico, not Roswell, where crashed craft were recovered, and there were a few such crashes in the 1940s. If true, it would mean the famous 1947 Roswell crash was not the only one.
